hooks.command: input=$(cat); tp=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.transcript_path // empty'); name=$(jq -rc 'select(.aiTitle) | .aiTitle' "$tp" 2>/dev/null | tail -1); [ -z "$name" ] && name=$(basename "$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.cwd // "Claude Code"')"); notify-send -a 'Claude Code' -u normal "$name" 'done' 2>/dev/null || true
